I wanted to share a product idea. I would love to have a thermal skirt to wrap around my thigh area. I find that this area is the coldest and most exposed on my body. If I could have a wrap / skirt to wear around my waist/thighs that would be amazing! 

 ~Christine Milovani

 Hello Christine, 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 We hope you’re doing well with the Holidays approaching.

 On our end, it’s been quite an intense week, with the publication of this newspaper article (https://ctrk.klclick1.com/l/01KBSZPJZER378K1V2CB4MS6BJ_0) where I opened up about the progress and challenges of the past year , in addition to sharing my thoughts on the future of Lasclay and the solutions to put in place to ensure the long-term sustainability of milkweed farming in North America. It stirred quite a bit of discussion!

 We also wanted to remind you that there’s just a little over a week left to enter our Grand November Contest , in which we are giving away (among other prizes) a trip to Mexico valued at over $5,000 , to explore the Monarch Butterfly Biosphere Reserve, listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site (https://ctrk.klclick1.com/l/01KBSZPJZER378K1V2CB4MS6BJ_1)—a dream for all lovers of milkweed and monarchs. 

 Reminder, just in case: 
 To participate, you must: 

 1. Like, share, and comment on the contest's Facebook post (https://ctrk.klclick1.com/l/01KBSZPJZER378K1V2CB4MS6BJ_2) 
 OR leave a review in any product's comment section on lasclay.com (https://ctrk.klclick1.com/l/01KBSZPJZER378K1V2CB4MS6BJ_3) 

 2. Make a purchase on lasclay.com (https://ctrk.klclick1.com/l/01KBSZPJZER378K1V2CB4MS6BJ_4) 

 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 We also want to take the time to thank you—and our entire wonderful community—for supporting our mission of popularizing milkweed while saving monarch butterflies for the past 5 years, through all our ups and downs.

 November 2025 was BY FAR the best sales month in Lasclay’s history , and December is on track to be TWICE as strong. 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 It’s a record-breaking season for us. Production is running at full speed, and our products are currently assembled across 4 different factories throughout Canada and USA . Very few items are out of stock , and we even caught up on shipping after this enormous November , thanks to several intense days of colossal effort during which my entire family came to help , and orders shipped by the thousands, on pallets. 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 It truly feels good to write this, after years of being swept up by growth that was a little too intense for our production capacity and always delivering at the last minute on December 23rd after a series of sleepless nights! In short, for once at this time of year, we’re a bit more in control of the situation , even if it’s not perfect and we’re in the thick of it! 

 We also wanted to remind you that our Return & Satisfaction guarantees , which allow you to return orders and receive an exchange or a refund even AFTER trying the products , have been extended until January 31st , so our customers can give gifts with complete confidence. 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Thank you so much Christine for being part of our community. Without our passionate customers, we and our milkweed farmers wouldn’t have come this far. And don’t hesitate to write to us if there’s ever anything at all! 

 Warmly,

 Gabriel 
Co-founder
Lasclay 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Lasclay inc.

 Hello Christine, 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 It’s cold this morning here in Quebec City! -37°C (-35°F).

 So it's quite weird to announce the Lasclay "end-of-winter" sale . 😅

 But we'll stick to our calendar, since we traditionally launch this sale toward the end of January, when the dust settles after November and December. And wow—what a season it’s been!

 Two massive months, by far the biggest in the history of our young company: 

 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 We are incredibly proud of this and see it as a sign that milkweed is beginning to break through on a larger scale. But now that the dust has settled, we are turning our focus back to our mission and looking ahead, at a time when the clock is ticking more than ever for monarch butterflies.

 We are not straying from our vision: to develop, as quickly as possible, real markets for milkweed crops, one of the last strongholds for the survival of monarch butterflies threatened with extinction. 

 This mission quite literally keeps us up at night, and we’ve been fortunate to be surrounded by an army of passionate people who have believed in it with us from the very beginning. Lasclay (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KFR5RFKNTZTR9ZQFWBFTN0D4_0) is a community. A community that has supported us since day one, trusted us, and given us the courage to build this ambitious company, dedicated to this extraordinary plant that is milkweed and to all the wildlife that depends on it.

 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 Every Lasclay product sold is a boost for the incredibly resilient milkweed growers, who have weathered the ups and downs of this very young industry since 2013. Every product that leaves our workshop is another step toward preserving, and even expanding milkweed fields, helping ensure a sustainable future for monarch butterflies.

 If you’d like to support our mission and stay warm for the rest of this winter and the seasons to come, we’re excited to announce our end-of-season sale , starting now , with limited stock reserved for our newsletter subscribers.

 After being nearly sold out in November and December, we’ve restocked almost all products which, as always, are expected to sell out very, very quickly.

 We’re offering a simple progressive discount for this sale, increasing with the number of items in your cart:

 2 items: 10% off your order 
 3–4 items: 15% off 
 5 items: 20% off 

 All Lasclay products are eligible. For a few days only, we’re also offering FREE SHIPPING on all orders. 

 Don't wait too long - our accountant won’t be happy and might shut this down! 😅 

 To take advantage of our end-of-season sale, just click the button below 👇 

 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Shop the Lasclay end-of-season sale (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KFR5RFKNTZTR9ZQFWBFTN0D4_1)
 

 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Have a great month of February 😉 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Warmly,

 Gabriel

messages.text:
Hi Christine,

Thank you for sharing this idea, and for taking the time to send it twice.

A thermal wrap skirt isn't something we currently make, but it's a genuinely interesting concept, and the milkweed insulation would be well suited for exactly that kind of targeted warmth. I'm passing your suggestion along to our product team.

In the meantime, if you're looking for something to help with lower-body warmth, our thermal insoles are handy for cold feet: https://lasclay.com/en/products/thermal-insoles, and we have a growing lineup of outerwear and accessories you can browse here: https://lasclay.com/en/collections/products

If a wrap skirt ever makes it into development, our newsletter subscribers tend to hear first.

Warmly,
__
 Gabriel Gouveia 
Co-founder
Lasclay.com
